findings.claim: t3Check flags any setAutoCommit(true) in the method as an error ('true keeps auto-commit on ... Use setAutoCommit(false)'). A learner who correctly restores auto-commit in a finally block after rollback/rethrow (the pattern the cited Oracle 'Using Transactions' tutorial shows) is rejected with misleading feedback (verified in node: throw e; and throw new RuntimeException(e); both pass, but adding finally { conn.setAutoCommit(true); } fails).
findings.recommendation: Only flag setAutoCommit(true) when it appears before the last executeUpdate/commit (or when no setAutoCommit(false) precedes the updates); allow it inside a finally block after the catch.

findings.claim: Objective o3 ('Predict what another session sees before and after a transaction commits or rolls back') is credited only by the timeline activity, which is pure button-press exploration with the answer shown immediately; the learner never predicts. Its required goals are auto, rb and iso; the 'move 50, commit, session 2 reads' scenario that shows the after-commit view is optional, so o3 can be marked done without seeing the after-commit half of the objective.
findings.recommendation: Add a required prediction before each session-2 read (choose what session 2 sees, then reveal), and add 'commit' to the step-2 goals so both before- and after-commit visibility are exercised.

findings.claim: The rethrow check accepts any 'throw new X(...e...)' whose argument mentions the catch variable, so throw new RuntimeException(e.getMessage()); passes even though the Problems message and the static alt say the wrapped exception must keep the original as the cause (verified in node).
findings.recommendation: Require the catch variable as a standalone argument (e.g. \(\s*(?:"[^"]*"\s*,\s*)?e\s*\)) rather than any word-boundary occurrence.

findings.claim: From step 4 on, the live model shows 'A 50 · B 70' and 'Committed transfer of 50', while the step-3 editor output just ended with a rolled-back transfer of 150 at A 100 · B 20. The unexplained state change can confuse the durability/isolation apply question.
findings.recommendation: Show the step-3 end state (A 100 · B 20) or label the card as the separate committed-transfer-of-50 scenario from the timeline.
